Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[Ytd Count] AS Count(Ytd()) MEMBER [Measures].[Mtd Sales] AS Sum(Mtd(), [Measures].[Unit Sales]) MEMBER [Measures].[Qtd] AS SetToStr(Qtd([Time].[1997].[Q3].[8])) SELECT {[Measures].[Ytd Count], [Measures].[Mtd Sales], [Measures].[Qtd]} ON 0, {[Time].[1997].[Q3].[8], [Time].[1997]} ON 1 FROM [ZFMSALES]
